tool.name: Generate GROMACS MDP File
tool.description: Generate a GROMACS .mdp file with presets + advanced controls
tool.command:
#if $advance_md_file_options.advance_md_file == 'wf' ln -s $advance_md_file_options.gro_file system.gro && (echo 'q') | gmx make_ndx -f system.gro > index_log.txt 2>&1 && #end if
python '$__tool_directory__/md_template.py'
#if $advance_md_file_options.advance_md_file == 'wf'
index --config $advance_md_file_options.conf_file --index_log index_log.txt --gro-file system.gro --output ndx.ndx
npt1 #if $advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nsteps' --nstxtcout '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nstxtcout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nstfout' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_tc_grps_conditional.npt1_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_tc_grps_conditional.npt1_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt1_conditional.npt1_tc_grps_conditional.npt1_comm_grps' #end if #end if
npt2 #if $advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nsteps' --nstxtcout '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nstxtcout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nstfout' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_tc_grps_conditional.npt2_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_tc_grps_conditional.npt2_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt2_conditional.npt2_tc_grps_conditional.npt2_comm_grps' #end if #end if
npt3 #if $advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nsteps' --nstxtcout '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nstxtcout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nstfout' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_tc_grps_conditional.npt3_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_tc_grps_conditional.npt3_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt3_conditional.npt3_tc_grps_conditional.npt3_comm_grps' #end if #end if
npt4 #if $advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nsteps' --nstxtcout '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nstxtcout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nstfout' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_tc_grps_conditional.npt4_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_tc_grps_conditional.npt4_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.npt4_conditional.npt4_tc_grps_conditional.npt4_comm_grps' #end if #end if
nvt1 #if $advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nsteps' --nstxtcout '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nstxtcout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nstfout' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_tc_grps_conditional.nvt1_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_tc_grps_conditional.nvt1_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.nvt1_conditional.nvt1_tc_grps_conditional.nvt1_comm_grps' #end if #end if
nvt2 #if $advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nsteps' --nstxtcout '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nstxtcout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nstfout' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_tc_grps_conditional.nvt2_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_tc_grps_conditional.nvt2_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.nvt2_conditional.nvt2_tc_grps_conditional.nvt2_comm_grps' #end if #end if
production #if $advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.production_mode == 'custom' --dt '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_dt' --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nsteps' --nstxout '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstxout' --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstvout' --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstfout' --nstxout_compressed '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstxout_compressed' --nstcalcenergy '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstcalcenergy' --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstenergy' --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_nstlog'
#if $advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_tc_grps_conditional.prod_tc_grps_option == 'custom' --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_tc_grps_conditional.prod_tc_grps' --comm_grps '$advance_md_file_options.production_conditional.prod_tc_grps_conditional.prod_comm_grps' #end if #end if #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.advance_md_file == 'custom' custom
##if $advance_md_file_options.presets.preset != 'blank' ## --preset '$advance_md_file_options.presets.preset' ##end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.presets.integrator != 'blank' --integrator '$advance_md_file_options.presets.integrator' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.presets.dt --dt '$advance_md_file_options.presets.dt' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.presets.nsteps --nsteps '$advance_md_file_options.presets.nsteps' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.presets.tinit --tinit '$advance_md_file_options.presets.tinit' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.presets.init_step --init_step '$advance_md_file_options.presets.init_step' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.presets.continuation != 'blank' --continuation '$advance_md_file_options.presets.continuation' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.cutoff_scheme != 'blank' --cutoff_scheme '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.cutoff_scheme' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.nstlist --nstlist '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.nstlist' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.pbc != 'blank' --pbc '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.pbc' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.verlet_buffer_tolerance --verlet_buffer_tolerance '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.verlet_buffer_tolerance' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.rlist --rlist '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.rlist' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.rcoulomb --rcoulomb '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.rcoulomb' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.rvdw --rvdw '$advance_md_file_options.nonbonded.rvdw' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.coulombtype != 'blank' --coulombtype '$advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.coulombtype' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.coulomb_modifier != 'blank' --coulomb_modifier '$advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.coulomb_modifier' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.fourierspacing --fourierspacing '$advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.fourierspacing' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.pme_order --pme_order '$advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.pme_order' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.ewald_rtol --ewald_rtol '$advance_md_file_options.electrostatics.ewald_rtol' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.vdw.vdwtype != 'blank' --vdwtype '$advance_md_file_options.vdw.vdwtype' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.vdw.vdw_modifier != 'blank' --vdw_modifier '$advance_md_file_options.vdw.vdw_modifier' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.vdw.dispcorr != 'blank' --dispcorr '$advance_md_file_options.vdw.dispcorr' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.tcoupl != 'blank' --tcoupl '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.tcoupl' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.tc_grps --tc_grps '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.tc_grps' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.tau_t --tau_t '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.tau_t' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.ref_t --ref_t '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.ref_t' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.nsttcouple --nsttcouple '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.nsttcouple' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.gen_vel != 'blank' --gen_vel '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.gen_vel' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.gen_temp --gen_temp '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.gen_temp' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.thermostat.gen_seed --gen_seed '$advance_md_file_options.thermostat.gen_seed' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.barostat.pcoupl != 'blank' --pcoupl '$advance_md_file_options.barostat.pcoupl' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.barostat.pcoupltype != 'blank' --pcoupltype '$advance_md_file_options.barostat.pcoupltype' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.barostat.tau_p --tau_p '$advance_md_file_options.barostat.tau_p' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.barostat.ref_p --ref_p '$advance_md_file_options.barostat.ref_p' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.barostat.compressibility --compressibility '$advance_md_file_options.barostat.compressibility' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.barostat.nstpcouple --nstpcouple '$advance_md_file_options.barostat.nstpcouple' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.constraints != 'blank' --constraints '$advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.constraints' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.constraint_algorithm != 'blank' --constraint_algorithm '$advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.constraint_algorithm' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.lincs_order --lincs_order '$advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.lincs_order' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.lincs_iter --lincs_iter '$advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.lincs_iter' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.shake_tol --shake_tol '$advance_md_file_options.constraints_sec.shake_tol' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.output.nstxout --nstxout '$advance_md_file_options.output.nstxout' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.output.nstvout --nstvout '$advance_md_file_options.output.nstvout' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.output.nstfout --nstfout '$advance_md_file_options.output.nstfout' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.output.nstlog --nstlog '$advance_md_file_options.output.nstlog' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.output.nstenergy --nstenergy '$advance_md_file_options.output.nstenergy' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.output.nstxout_compressed --nstxout_compressed '$advance_md_file_options.output.nstxout_compressed' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.output.compressed_x_precision --compressed_x_precision '$advance_md_file_options.output.compressed_x_precision' #end if
#if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull != 'blank' --pull '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_ngroups --pull_ngroups '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_ngroups' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_ncoords --pull_ncoords '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_ncoords' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_groups --pull_groups '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_groups' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_type != 'blank' --pull_coord1_type '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_type' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_geometry != 'blank' --pull_coord1_geometry '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_geometry' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_dim --pull_coord1_dim '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_dim' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_vec --pull_coord1_vec '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_vec' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_init --pull_coord1_init '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_init' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_rate --pull_coord1_rate '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_rate' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_k --pull_coord1_k '$advance_md_file_options.pulling.pull_coord1_k' #end if #if $advance_md_file_options.expert.extra_mdp --extra_mdp '$advance_md_file_options.expert.extra_mdp' #end if --output custom.mdp #end if
&&
#if $advance_md_file_options.advance_md_file == 'wf' mv npt1.mdp '$npt1_out' && mv npt2.mdp '$npt2_out' && mv npt3.mdp '$npt3_out' && mv npt4.mdp '$npt4_out' && mv nvt1.mdp '$nvt1_out' && mv nvt2.mdp '$nvt2_out' && mv production.mdp '$prod_out' && (echo 'q') | gmx make_ndx -n ndx.ndx > '$groups_out' 2>&1 && mv ndx.ndx '$index_out'
#elif $advance_md_file_options.advance_md_file == 'custom' mv custom.mdp '$custom_out' #end if

param.name: advance_md_file
param.label: MDP file generation mode
param.help: Choose whether to generate a complete simulation workflow or a single custom MDP file.
param.option: Generate workflow MDP and index files (equilibration + production)
Generate a single custom MDP file

param.name: preset
param.label: Preset configuration
param.help: Select a preset to auto-populate common parameter values for specific simulation types.

param.name: integrator
param.label: Integrator algorithm
param.help: Select the molecular dynamics integrator. Overrides preset value if specified.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: dt
param.label: Integration time step (dt)
param.help: Time step in picoseconds. Typical values: 0.001-0.002 ps for all-atom simulations.

param.name: nsteps
param.label: Total simulation steps (nsteps)
param.help: Total number of simulation steps. Total time = dt × nsteps.

param.name: tinit
param.label: Initial simulation time (tinit)
param.help: Starting time for the simulation in picoseconds. Usually 0.0.

param.name: init_step
param.label: Initial step number (init-step)
param.help: Starting step number. Used when restarting simulations.

param.name: continuation
param.label: Continuation from checkpoint
param.help: Set to 'yes' when continuing from a previous simulation checkpoint.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: cutoff_scheme
param.label: Cut-off scheme
param.help: Neighbor list algorithm. Verlet is required for GPU acceleration.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: nstlist
param.label: Neighbor list update frequency (nstlist)
param.help: Frequency (in steps) for updating the neighbor list. Set to 10-20 for Verlet scheme.

param.name: pbc
param.label: Periodic boundary conditions (pbc)
param.help: Type of periodic boundary conditions applied to the system.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: verlet_buffer_tolerance
param.label: Verlet buffer tolerance
param.help: Maximum allowed error in pair list for Verlet scheme (kJ/mol/ps).

param.name: rlist
param.label: Neighbor list cut-off radius (rlist)
param.help: Cut-off distance for the neighbor list in nanometers.

param.name: rcoulomb
param.label: Coulomb interaction cut-off (rcoulomb)
param.help: Cut-off distance for Coulomb interactions in nanometers.

param.name: rvdw
param.label: Van der Waals cut-off (rvdw)
param.help: Cut-off distance for van der Waals interactions in nanometers.

param.name: coulombtype
param.label: Coulomb interaction type
param.help: Method for calculating long-range electrostatic interactions. PME is recommended for most simulations.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: coulomb_modifier
param.label: Coulomb modifier
param.help: Modification applied to electrostatic interactions at the cut-off.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: fourierspacing
param.label: Fourier grid spacing
param.help: Grid spacing for PME FFT in nanometers. Smaller values increase accuracy but cost more.

param.name: pme_order
param.label: PME interpolation order
param.help: Interpolation order for PME. 4 (cubic) is standard; 6 gives higher accuracy.

param.name: ewald_rtol
param.label: Ewald tolerance (ewald-rtol)
param.help: Relative strength of the Ewald-shifted direct potential at the cut-off.

param.name: vdwtype
param.label: Van der Waals interaction type
param.help: Method for calculating van der Waals interactions.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: vdw_modifier
param.label: Van der Waals modifier
param.help: Modification applied to VdW interactions at the cut-off to improve energy conservation.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: dispcorr
param.label: Dispersion correction
param.help: Long-range dispersion correction for energy and/or pressure.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: tcoupl
param.label: Temperature coupling algorithm
param.help: Thermostat algorithm for temperature control. V-rescale is recommended for equilibration; Nose-Hoover for production.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: tc_grps
param.label: Temperature coupling groups (tc-grps)
param.help: Space-separated list of atom groups for temperature coupling. Example: 'System' or 'Protein SOL'. Groups must match those defined in the index file.

param.name: tau_t
param.label: Temperature coupling time constant (tau-t)
param.help: Time constant for temperature coupling in picoseconds. Provide one value per group. Example: '0.1 0.1'

param.name: ref_t
param.label: Reference temperature (ref-t)
param.help: Reference temperature in Kelvin for each coupling group. Example: '300 300'

param.name: nsttcouple
param.label: Temperature coupling frequency (nsttcouple)
param.help: Frequency for temperature coupling. -1 means automatic selection based on tau-t.

param.name: gen_vel
param.label: Generate initial velocities
param.help: Generate velocities from Maxwell distribution at the start of the simulation.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: gen_temp
param.label: Initial velocity temperature (K)
param.help: Temperature in Kelvin for generating initial velocities.

param.name: gen_seed
param.label: Random seed for velocity generation
param.help: Random seed for velocity generation. -1 uses a pseudo-random seed.

param.name: pcoupl
param.label: Pressure coupling algorithm
param.help: Barostat algorithm for pressure control. Parrinello-Rahman is recommended for production; Berendsen or C-rescale for equilibration.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: pcoupltype
param.label: Pressure coupling type
param.help: Type of pressure scaling. Use semiisotropic for membrane systems.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file
Semiisotropic (xy coupled, z independent - for membranes)

param.name: tau_p
param.label: Pressure coupling time constant (tau-p)
param.help: Time constant for pressure coupling in picoseconds. Typical values: 1.0-5.0 ps.

param.name: ref_p
param.label: Reference pressure (ref-p)
param.help: Reference pressure in bar. For semiisotropic coupling, provide two values (e.g., '1.0 1.0').

param.name: compressibility
param.label: Compressibility (bar^-1)
param.help: System compressibility. For water at 300K use 4.5e-5. For semiisotropic, provide two values (e.g., '4.5e-5 4.5e-5').

param.name: nstpcouple
param.label: Pressure coupling frequency (nstpcouple)
param.help: Frequency for pressure coupling. -1 means automatic selection based on tau-p.

param.name: constraints
param.label: Constraint type
param.help: Type of bond constraints to apply. H-bonds allows 2 fs timestep; all-bonds allows up to 4 fs.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: constraint_algorithm
param.label: Constraint algorithm
param.help: Algorithm for applying constraints. LINCS is faster and parallelizes better; SHAKE is more accurate.
param.option: Omit this parameter from MDP file

param.name: lincs_order
param.label: LINCS expansion order
param.help: Order of the LINCS expansion. Higher values increase accuracy but cost more. Default: 4.

param.name: lincs_iter
param.label: LINCS iteration number
param.help: Number of iterations to correct for rotational lengthening. Increase for large molecules.

param.name: shake_tol
param.label: SHAKE tolerance
param.help: Relative tolerance for SHAKE algorithm.

param.name: nstxout
param.label: Full-precision coordinate output frequency (nstxout)
param.help: Frequency (in steps) for writing full-precision coordinates to .trr file. 0 disables output.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
This tool generates GROMACS molecular dynamics parameter (.mdp) files for running simulations. It provides two modes of operation:
1. **Workflow Mode**: Generates a complete multi-stage MD simulation protocol including equilibration phases (NVT and NPT) and production run, along with a GROMACS index file (.ndx) 2. **Custom Mode**: Creates a single .mdp file with full control over all simulation parameters
-----
**Input Requirements**
*Workflow Mode:*
- **Configuration file**: Either from the Membrane Builder tool or manually created, containing group definitions - **Structure file (.gro)**: GROMACS coordinate file with atom positions and box dimensions
Example configuration file format::
- lipid:PA,PC,OL,CHL - ligand:CAU - ions:NA+,Cl-
*Custom Mode:*
No input files required. All parameters are configured through the interface.
-----
**Outputs**
*Workflow Mode* produces:
- **npt1.mdp - npt4.mdp**: Four-stage NPT equilibration with progressively reduced position restraints - **nvt1.mdp, nvt2.mdp**: NVT equilibration for temperature stabilization - **production.mdp**: Production MD parameters for data collection - **index.ndx**: GROMACS index file with atom group definitions - **groups.txt**: Human-readable list of available index groups
*Custom Mode* produces:
- **custom.mdp**: Single customized MDP file with user-specified parameters
-----
**Equilibration Protocol**
The workflow mode implements a standard equilibration protocol for membrane protein simulations:
1. **NVT1/NVT2**: Temperature equilibration at constant volume 2. **NPT1**: Initial pressure coupling with strong position restraints 3. **NPT2**: Intermediate stage with reduced restraints 4. **NPT3**: Further relaxation with minimal restraints 5. **NPT4**: Final equilibration before production 6. **Production**: Unrestrained production MD for analysis
-----
**Key Parameters Explained**
*Time Step (dt)*: Integration time step in picoseconds. Use 0.001-0.002 ps for all-atom simulations with constrained hydrogen bonds.
*Temperature Coupling*: - **V-rescale**: Recommended for equilibration; produces correct canonical ensemble - **Nose-Hoover**: Recommended for production; proper canonical ensemble - **Berendsen**: Fast equilibration but does not produce correct ensemble; use only for initial equilibration
*Pressure Coupling*: - **Parrinello-Rahman**: Recommended for production MD - **C-rescale**: Good for equilibration, produces correct NPT ensemble - **Berendsen**: Only for initial equilibration; does not give correct ensemble - Use **semiisotropic** coupling for membrane systems
*Constraints*: - **h-bonds**: Constrain bonds involving hydrogen; allows 2 fs timestep - **all-bonds**: Constrain all bonds; allows up to 4 fs timestep
-----
**Multi-Group Temperature Coupling**
For systems with multiple components, use separate temperature coupling groups::
tc-grps = Protein Membrane Water_and_ions tau-t = 0.1 0.1 0.1 ref-t = 300 300 300
Groups must match those defined in your index file.
-----
**Tips and Best Practices**
- Always verify generated MDP files before production runs - Use **Energy Minimization** before any MD simulation - Equilibrate the system gradually before production - For membrane systems, use **semiisotropic** pressure coupling - Check that temperature coupling groups match your index file definitions - Use the "Additional MDP parameters" section for any GROMACS options not exposed in the interface
-----
**References**
- `GROMACS Manual <http://manual.gromacs.org/>`_ - `MDP Parameter Reference <http://manual.gromacs.org/documentation/current/user-guide/mdp-options.html>`_
